parameters: \rIt's finally time for chapter two.\nHere we go!
\rAt last, right?\nHah! I know you're thrilled.
\rThe meteors shone with a rainbow brilliance, as if some great life was held within.
\rThat was when, as if drawn by the brilliance, a Pokémon that shone in a blazing emerald hue descended from the heavens…
\rThat Pokémon was none other than Rayquaza.
\rRayquaza's power overwhelmed that of the two Primal Pokémon, and peace returned to the world.
\rThe people of Hoenn revered Rayquaza as a true savior.
\rA thousand years after this time, the meteoroids once again fell.
\rA huge meteoroid, far greater than any before, struck the planet, boring deep into the ocean and leaving behind it a crater larger than any other.
\rThe land born of this event later become known as Sootopolis.
\rAnd that is it!\nChapter two is over!
\rBut we've only just left the starting line.\nThere's a long way yet--don't fall behind now!
